        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, when transporting or offering for transport any unloaded firearm(s).",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "C002",
          "F000",
          "F001"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F000:F001",
        "choice_text": "All conditions must be satisfied: the firearm must be unloaded; the firearm must be carried in a hard-sided container; and the container in which it is carried must be locked, with the passenger retaining either the key or the combination.",
        "logic_quote": "F000",
        "references": [
          "§ 1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger must not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unloaded firearm unless the firearm is unloaded, carried in a hard-sided container, and carried in a locked container for which only the passenger retains the key or combination."
      }
